t: The Nanny: California, Here We Come?
d: When Maxwell wants to produce a television show, Fran worries about what her moving to California will do to Sylvia.
After confronting Sylvia about her affair, Fran sets out to save her parent's marriage.
Niles enlists Fran in an effort to impress C.C. by producing a play.
Humiliated after C.C. turns down his marriage proposal, Niles decides to quit his job with the Sheffields.
Maxwell battles an old rival for the rights to the story of Yetta's love life.
Fran and Maxwell disagree when Maggie wants to get married.
A psychic predicts that Maxwell is going to leave Fran for another woman.
As she worries about getting too fat, Fran goes into labor while stuck in an elevator with C.C.
Fran delivers her twins as C.C. gives Niles an answer to his marriage proposal.
A door-to-door cosmetics saleswoman falls into a job as a wealthy family's nanny.

t: The Nanny: Smoke Gets In Your Lies
d: Brighton is caught smoking at school.
Fran hosts a society tea for debutante Maggie.
Fran's help getting Maggie a date backfires.

t: The Nanny: Here Comes The Brood
d: Jealous of Fran, C.C. tries to court favor with Maxwell's children.

t: The Nanny: The Butler, The Husband, The Wife And Her Mother
st: The Butler, The Husband, The Wife And Her Mother
d: Fran persuades the family to help her dupe a nosy cousin.
Fran accidentally kills Grace's imaginary friend.
Fran spends her first Christmas with the Sheffields.
Fran is enlisted to help land a soap opera star for Maxwell's musical.
Fran contends with Maxwell's old nanny.

t: The Nanny: A Plot For Nanny
d: Fran's birthday gift leads to a date with a handsome mortician.

t: The Nanny: The Show Must Go On
d: Fran and Maxwell clash over Grace's school pageant.
Chloe Simpson, a 1960s supermodel, re-enters ex-flame Maxwell's life, turning the Sheffield household upside down and interfering with the relationship between Fran and Maggie.
Maxwell reveals he has a double standard when it comes to his children and the opposite sex.

While examining Grace, the doctor orders Fran to the hospital to have her tonsils removed. Meanwhile, C.C. convinces Maxwell to attend her college reunion, but her plans are foiled when Maxwell stands her up in order to stay by Fran's bedside.

The entire Sheffield clan spends the weekend at Fran's parents' house when a blizzard closes the airports. Maggie falls for the boy next door, C.C. crawls in bed with Niles, and Fran finds a love note to her mother -- that's not from her father.

t: The Nanny: Stop The Wedding, I Want To Get Off
st: Stop The Wedding, I Want To Get Off
d: Maxwell's sister Jocelyn gets engaged to Nigel, the Duke of Salisbury, but the wedding seems ill-fated after Fran discovers that Jocelyn is really in love with her chauffeur, Lester.

t: The Nanny: Sunday In The Park With Fran
st: Sunday In The Park With Fran
d: Grace and the son of a prominent theater critic Frank Bradley get in a fight during a trip to the park, and, to break it up, Fran bops the boy with a baguette -- which could mean curtains for Maxwell's newest Broadway play.
Fran's nightmare high school gym teacher has a new job as Maggie's instructor -- and Fran goes back to school to help Maggie pass her gymnastics final.

t: The Nanny: Ode To Barbra Joan
d: Fran finds herself coming between C.C. and her dad.
A marriage proposal threatens Fran's future with the Sheffields.

t: The Nanny: I Don't Remember Mama
d: Trouble arises when Fran and Grace enter a mother-daughter beauty contest.
Maxwell dates Fran's double; Brighton has problems with junior high.
Fran discovers an old admirer who just won't go away, while Brighton tries to avoid dating an unpopular classmate.

t: The Nanny: Everybody Needs A Bubby Sometimes
d: Fran's grandmother moves in and begins giving Maggie advice about sex.
An elderly admirer courts Fran.

t: The Nanny: Curse Of The Grandmas
d: Fran anxiously anticipates a big party on her first anniversary with the Sheffields.
